# Lohith Lalesh

> Lohith Lalesh is a Dubai-based marketing operator who moves between strategy,
> content, paid media, SEO/AEO, landing pages, automation, AI workflows, analytics,
> and creative production. This site is his portfolio, certification board, field
> notes, and visitor wall.

## About

- Name: Lohith Lalesh
- Role: Marketing operator / digital marketing specialist
- Location: Dubai, UAE
- Focus: marketing systems, content production, paid media, social media growth, SEO/AEO, landing pages, automation, AI-assisted workflows, creative assets, tracking, and analytics
- Contact: lohithlalesh@gmail.com

## Key pages

- [Home / Portfolio](https://lohithlalesh.com/): visual portfolio, operating message, Scorsese quote, working modes, tool stack, certifications, field notes, contact links, and visitor wall.

## Articles

- [The programmatic ads hack: real power, real fraud, and how much is hoax](https://lohithlalesh.com/blog/programmatic-ads-hack-or-hoax.html): a marketer's view on programmatic supply, fraud, transparency, and practical buying discipline.
- [Claude Skills, ranked: the GitHub repos a marketer should steal](https://lohithlalesh.com/blog/claude-skills-from-github.html): what Claude Skills are, why they matter, and which repos/tasks are useful for marketers.
- [AI fluency is the new baseline for marketers](https://lohithlalesh.com/blog/ai-fluency-for-marketers.html): the difference between tool knowledge and fluency, plus a practical course path.
- [I lost 40 kg. It rebuilt my career more than any course.](https://lohithlalesh.com/blog/losing-40kg-career-lessons.html): a personal essay on discipline, identity, consistency, and work.
- [What my first blog taught me about Google indexing](https://lohithlalesh.com/blog/how-i-learned-google-indexing.html): a simple explanation of crawling, indexing, ranking, long-tail keywords, and title specificity.
- [Why paid media starts before Ads Manager](https://lohithlalesh.com/blog/paid-media-before-ads-manager.html): audience, offer, hook, landing path, and proof before ad spend.
- [A content calendar isn't a schedule. It's a delivery system.](https://lohithlalesh.com/blog/content-calendar-delivery-system.html): treating content planning as a production workflow with inputs, states, owners, and done criteria.
